baselineComparison.case: Finite successful JSON acknowledgement with ok=true and padding exceeding 16 KiB

limits: The deadline covers pushApi only, not Notification permission, service-worker readiness, native subscribe/unsubscribe or the entire user action. Native delivery/permission timing remains unverified.

not_started means the API POST was not dispatched; earlier native permission/subscription work may already have happened. After dispatch timeout/cancellation cannot undo or prove rollback of writes. Unknown-write latch/read-only reconciliation and durable receipt/cross-device ordering remain open.

Response bounds apply to bytes exposed by browser fetch, not a platform/network allocation cap. Timers are cooperative, not hard CPU preemption. SDK lookup itself cannot be cancelled, but late completion cannot dispatch after the owned signal ends.
